dedupe_keys.name: code and computational artifacts for the phd thesis wind farm collection system optimization for integrated design

description: Mauricio Souza de Alencar at DTU publishes code and computational artifacts for wind-farm collector-cable routing. Zenodo lists two public archives under CC BY 4.0: a Data-Driven Hybrid heuristic and analysis notebooks for OptiWindNet route sets. The description identifies a constructive link-selection method with neural-network, XGBoost or linear appraisers. It specifies an ordered notebook pipeline for feature extraction, training, threshold tuning and evaluation against near-optimal route sets. This model can compare cable-layout designs and test cost or topology sensitivity for offshore wind collection systems. No related catalogue record explicitly includes this released heuristic; the separately described route-set dataset is an input, not a duplicate model. Coverage is benchmark route-set instances, including a held-out sample, not a fully engineered cable design for a built farm. A limitation is that paper figures and reported cable-length gaps depend on the supplied partitions and trained files. Neither archive was opened, and the evaluation was not reproduced.
